entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath day.>> [It is] good to give thanks to the LORD, And to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: To declare Your lovingkindness in the morning, And Your faithfulness every night,

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments: On an instrument of ten strings, On the lute, And on the harp, With harmonious sound.

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: For You, LORD, have made me glad through Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: O LORD, how great are Your works! Your thoughts are very deep.

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: A senseless man does not know, Nor does a fool understand this.

entries.title: Psalms 92:7
segments: ¶When the wicked spring up like grass, And when all the workers of iniquity flourish, [It is] that they may be destroyed forever.

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments: But You, LORD, [are] on high forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: For behold, Your enemies, O LORD, For behold, Your enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: But my horn You have exalted like a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: My eye also has seen [my desire] on my enemies; My ears hear [my desire] on the wicked Who rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
segments: Those who are planted in the house of the LORD Shall flourish in the courts of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
segments: They shall still bear fruit in old age; They shall be fresh and flourishing,

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: To declare that the LORD is upright; [He is] my rock, and [there is] no unrighteousness in Him.
